description: This file defines the OrganizationService class within the OrangeHRM Admin Service namespace. It provides methods to access and modify organization information, interacting with the OrganizationDao for data persistence.

classes.name: OrganizationService
classes.description: Service class for managing organization data, acting as a bridge between controllers and data access objects.

methods.name: getOrganizationDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the OrganizationDao instance used by this service.

methods.name: setOrganizationDao
methods.description: Setter to explicitly assign the OrganizationDao instance.

methods.name: getOrganizationGeneralInformation
methods.description: Retrieves general information about the organization from the DAO.

methods.name: saveOrganizationGeneralInformation
methods.description: Saves the provided Organization object via the DAO, may throw a TransactionException.
